title: CoRe: Jointly Learning Contextual Representations for Understanding and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce CoRe, in which understanding and generation jointly shape one contextual representation for images and one for text, trained from scratch. Each representation is read for understanding, conditions the other modality, and is the space in which that modality is generated by a continuous flow from Gaussian noise. With 383M parameters trained on CC12M and no pretrained language model, text encoder, or VAE at inference, CoRe matches a same-data contrastive-only baseline in global understanding and reaches COCO-30K FID 10.10, comparable to much larger generators built on pretrained components. In controlled comparisons at equal data and architecture, CoRe generates better in both directions (text to image and image to text) than a representation shaped by understanding alone and then frozen, and follows prompts better than generating in a space that understanding does not shape. translated_title: CoRe：联合学习用于理解与生成的上下文表征
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CoRe，其中理解与生成共同塑造针对图像和针对文本各自的一个上下文表征，并从零开始训练。每个表征既被读取用于理解，又对另一模态进行条件化，同时还是该模态从高斯噪声出发经由连续流（continuous flow）进行生成的空间。在CC12M数据集上训练的383M参数模型，在推理阶段无需预训练语言模型、文本编码器或VAE，CoRe在全局理解任务上与相同数据量的纯对比学习基线相当，并达到COCO-30K FID 10.10，可与基于预训练组件构建的更大规模生成器相媲美。在相同数据和架构的对照比较中，CoRe在两个方向（文本到图像和图像到文本）的生成表现都优于仅由理解任务塑造后冻结的表征，并且在遵循提示方面也优于在与理解无关的表征空间中进行生成。在另一个方向上，使用注意力分割（摘要截断）……
tldr: CoRe提出让理解与生成任务联合塑造统一的图像与文本上下文表征，一个从零训练的383M模型在无需任何预训练组件的情况下，在理解能力以及文生图、图生文生成效果上均可与基于预训练组件的更大规模模型相媲美。
